text: 金十数据8月5日讯，8月4日，中国人民银行广东省分行召开2026年下半年工作会议暨广东外汇管理工作会议。会议强调，要继续落实适度宽松的货币政策，助力广东经济稳住增长势头；加力支持重点领域和薄弱环节，提升金融服务实体经济质效；续深化外汇管理改革，提升跨境贸易投融资便利化水平；充分发挥维护金融稳定和宏观审慎管理职能，守牢不发生系统性金融风险的底线。会议要求，一是推进外汇领域制度型开放，促进贸易投融资便利化。二是大力优化外汇服务，助力涉外经济高质量发展。三是强化外汇业务监管，筑牢外部冲击防波堤防浪堤。
text_en: Jin10 Data, August 5: On August 4, the Guangdong Branch of the People's Bank of China held its 2026 H2 work conference and Guangdong foreign exchange management work meeting. The meeting emphasized continuing to implement a moderately loose monetary policy to help Guangdong's economy maintain growth momentum; stepping up support for key areas and weak links to improve the quality and efficiency of financial services to the real economy; continuing to deepen foreign exchange management reform to enhance the facilitation of cross-border trade and investment financing; and fully exercising functions of maintaining financial stability and macroprudential management to hold the bottom line of preventing systemic financial risks. The meeting required: first, advancing institutional opening in the foreign exchange field to promote trade and investment facilitation; second, vigorously optimizing foreign exchange services to support high-quality development of the foreign-related economy; third, strengthening foreign exchange business supervision to build a breakwater against external shocks.
